description:
Append a response to feedback received from a client. Must be called by the agent that received the feedback. Requires an unlocked wallet.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

agentId.description: Agent ID that received the feedback

client.description: Stacks address of the client (SP... mainnet or ST... testnet)

fee.description: Fee preset ("low", "medium", "high") or micro-STX amount. Optional.

responseHash.description: Response hash as hex string (32 bytes)

responseUri.description: URI pointing to the response content

sponsored.description: Use sponsored transaction relay so a relay service pays fees instead of your wallet. Requires SPONSOR_API_KEY env var or wallet-level sponsorApiKey.

name: reputation_append_response
